Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. The Proteas have a take a 1-0 lead in this two-match T20I series. These two will cross swords again in the final game of the series on 5th August, 2022. The first ball will be bowled at 11 pm IST (5.30 pm GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye.

Keshav Maharaj, the victorious stand-in skipper is in for a chat. He says that David Miller woke up with a niggle and he was unable to take the field today. Says the boys played well and the win is the cherry on the top. Admits that the reserve players are performing well as they did against England as well and this will only prove to be a headache for the coaches. He says that they knew they had a good total on the board but Lorcan Tucker and George Dockrell played really well. Credits the bowlers for doing well to restrict Ireland towards the end. Says they will be taking rest the following day.

Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, is in for a chat. He starts by saying in T20I games these days 200 is expected to be chased down. Feels they were in the game for a long but losing two set batters on consecutive deliveries took the game away from them. Says that they have proven to perform well against these top side but it only depends on how they close these games and hopes they are able to change their fortune by levelling the series.

Reeza Hendricks wins the PLAYER OF THE MATCH award for his incredible knock. He says that he has been working really hard for weeks and even years and that is helping him at this moment. He agrees to the fact that he is enjoying the English conditions. Says that they lost a couple of wickets early and Aiden Markram played really well to support him and set up the game. Admits that there is a lot of quality on the sidelines and it is good to see the players taking their chances.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, South African innings was led by Reeza Hendricks with his fourth half-century on the trot in T20Is. He found a great partner in Aiden Markram and they managed to stable the ship for the side. Later, some hard-hitting of Tristan Stubbs and Dwaine Pretorius helped them to set a target of 212. During the chase, Ireland were in the game for a long time, but losing George Dockrell and Lorcan Tucker in quick succession took the game away from them.

It is the death bowlers that have managed to seal the game for South Africa here. Taking nothing away from the two spinners, who worked in tandem in the middle to tighten the screws but the way the seamers ended this innings was just outstanding. Wayne Parnell nailed five yorkers in the final over before getting smacked for a maximum, while Lungi Ngidi dominated with his slower balls. Tabraiz Shamsi, Wayne Parnell and Keshav Maharaj picked up a brace each, while the rest of the bowlers took a wicket apiece.

Chasing 200 and above always gets tricky in the shortest format of the game, although Ireland put up a fight right till the end. Both their openers departed inside the Powerplay after getting starts. The chances looked bleak after Tector slipped out on a timid score. It seems like Lorcan Tucker might be loving his new role at number 3 as he smacked 78 runs. He along with George Dockrell stitched a 86-run stand at the rate of knots. The Irish looked to be back on track but these two batters fell is quick succession which put them on the back foot yet again. It was tough ask for the tail-enders and they crumbled under the impressive death bowling of the Proteas.
Wow! This was a feast to be honest. A great game of cricket overall. South Africa did come out victorious but Ireland gave them a run for their money.

SIX! A great end to the innings by Barry McCarthy although in vain. Wayne Parnell serves this full and on an off stump line. Misses his yorker here as Barry McCarthy gets his front foot out of the way to pound this straight back over the bowler towards the long on fence for a maximum! There is a huge cheer from the crowd to see Ireland end with a biggie. South Africa have secured a 21-run victory.
Five dots in a row! Full length, wide outside off, even outside the tramline. Barry McCarthy shuffles way across but is unable to get any blade on it.
Incredible bowling from Parnell. He fires in full, wide outside off. Barry McCarthy tries to dig it out but he is late into his attempt.
Wide yorker, outside off. Barry McCarthy is unable to chase it.

Full length, wide outside off, angled across the right-hander. Barry McCarthy throws his balde at it but only connects with this air. Mathematically. Wayne Parnell has sealed the game for his side if he does not bowl any illegal deliveries.
Pernell fires in a yorker, outside off. Barry McCarthy tries to chase it but misses.
Josh Little is the last man in. Wayne Parnell to bowl the last over.

OUT! RUN OUT!! Some poor running between the wickets and Ireland are just collapsing here! Lungi Ngidi bowls this short and outside off, Barry McCarthy pulls this towards deep square leg and takes off for a single. They look for a second that is not there and Andy McBrine is far down the pitch when Barry McCarthy says no. Heinrich Klaasen does well on the boundary to collect the ball and throw it to the wicket-keeper right over the stumps. Quinton de Kock has all the time in the world to whip the bails off. Ireland have lost their ninth wicket!
Commentary.Howout: run out (Heinrich Klaasen / Quinton de Kock)

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, on off. Andy McBrine pulls it to deeo mid-wicket for one.

SIX! All the way! Andy McBrine has some fight left in him. Lungi Ngidi comes 'round the wicket and angles it in full and on off Andy McBrine gets low and smokes it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Another off-cutter from Lungi Ngidi as he serves this short and outside off, Barry McCarthy mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
Barry McCarthy comes in at number 10.

OUT! TIMBER! Lungi Ngidi strikes and Mark Adair has to depart! Lungi Ngidi bowls a off-cutter and aims it for the stumps. Mark Adair looks to swing across the line of the ball and is too early into his shot. The ball shatters into the stumps and Mark Adair has not been able to connect any of his shots! Ireland are now eight down!
Length ball, outside off, Adair swing hard and misses.
Change. Lungi Ngidi is back into the attack now.
Short one, down leg. Andy McBrine pulls it to deep square leg for a brace.
Serves a full toss outside off, Mark Adair gets the toe end of his bat and works the ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full and really wide outside off, Mark Adair has stepped almost towards the wide line to play this leg side. Leaves it at the last moment and looks for a wide. The umpire remains unmoved.
This is full and on the pads, Andy McBrine knocks this down to long on for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius bangs this in short and wide outside off, Mark Adair is way across to the offside and guides this at the last moment to short third man and takes a quick single.
Andy McBrine comes in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ireland are just falling apart now! Both the set batters have been dismissed on consecutive deliveries! Dwaine Pretorius bowls a low full toss wide outside off, George Dockrell looks to lift this over long off but does not connect this well at all. Aiden Markram comes running in from long off and takes a wonderful catch diving forward! Ireland have lost their seventh wicket and are in a bit of trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: Mark Adair makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Quinton de Kock almost makes a mess of the catch, but eventually gathers it. It is full and on off. Lorcan Tucker looks to sweep it away. It takes the top edge and lobs over the keeper's head. Quinton de Kock turns and chases it, it spills out of his palms but Quinton de Kock makes no mistake on his second bite. A huge blow for Ireland.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This time he disects the fielders in the deep. Short ball, on leg. Lorcan Tucker stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket. He finds the gap and it races away. Lorcan Tucker is turning the game on its head.

SIX! Lorcan Tucker is on the charge. It is short and on middle. Lorcan Tucker comes down the track and pulls it towards cow corner. Aiden Markram is stationed in the deep, he leaps near the fence but evades him for a maximum.
Lorcan Tucker moves to the leg side and Tabraiz Shamsi follows him with a full delivery. Lorcan Tucker flicks it powerfully to deep mid-wicket It is straight to the fielder and they take two more.
Good running! It is looped up, on the pads, Tucker comes down the flicks it to deep square leg. The batters push hard and come back for two.
Full and on off. George Dockrell tucks it to long on for a single.
A great over by Dwaine Pretorius comes to an end. Only 7 runs off it. Low full toss, outside off. Lorcan Tucker whips it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full length, wide outside the tramline. Lorcan Tucker leaves it alone. Wided.
George Dockrell could make the most of the Free Hit and shift the momentum on his side. It is on off. George Dockrell swings hard, it goes towards covers and they take one.

A wide yorker, way outside the tramline. George Dockrell could've left it but he reaches out and pushes it to covers. He calls for a single but slips inside the crease and decides against the single. Although, the umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps. A Free Hit to follow.
A low full toss, outside off. Lorcan Tucker shuffles across and slaps it down to long off for one.
Goes full and wide yet again. George Dockrell shuffles and slices it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius fires is a yorker, wide outside off. Dockrell tries to chase it but misses.
Good length, around off. George Dockrell stands tall and crunches it to sweeper cover for a brace.
Lungi Ngidi serves this on a good length and just outside off, George Dockrell lifts this into the air and falls just short of long off and they take a single.
Goes back to bowling full and outside off, Slower in the air once again and Lorcan Tucker works this towards extra cover for a single.

FOUR! Lorcan Tucker finally gets bat on ball and with good result! Lungi Ngidi goes for the slower bouncer outside off, Lorcan Tucker waits for the off cutter and gets into position to pull the ball into the gap at deep square leg for a much-needed boundary!
Another slower delivery bowled full and wide outside off, Lorcan Tucker is not being able to read the pace as he swings and gets beaten once again.
Serves a slower delivery full this time and outside off, Lorcan Tucker looks to get bat to this but misses.
Lungi Ngidi bowls a slower bouncer, outside off. George Dockrell looks to pull and gets a top edge that lands safely in the vacant square leg region. They take a run in the meantime.
Goes back to bowling on a full length outside off, George Dockrell knocks this to long off and takes a single to keep strike.

SIX! This has been deposited into the stands! This is an attemoted yorker that ends up as a full toss just outside off, George Dockrell gets under this and lifts it back over the bowlers head for a huge hit! What a cameo this has been from George Dockrell so far.
Wayne Parnell bowls a yorker wide outside off, George Dockrell comes down the wicket and gets beaten on the outside edge.
That is the 50-run partnership between the two! Wayne Parnell serves this one full as well outside off, Lorcan Tucker punches this down to long off for a run.
Full once again and outside off, Lorcan Tucker lifts this over cover and gets couple of runs as the fielder at long off cuts it off.
Wayne Parnell begins with a full delivery and wide outside off, George Dockrell gets bat to it and hits it towards the cover fielder. they take a single.

SIX! BANG! Lorcan Tucker gets to his FIFTY in style! Dwaine Pretorius serves it on a length, on middle. Lorcan Tucker uses his feet well. Makes room for himself and smokes it over the long off fence for a maximum.
The umpires are choosing a new ball, as the previous one gets lost in the stands.

FOUR! Lungi Ngidi does not give his everything in the deep. It is a full toss, on the pads, Lorcan Tucker stays back and whips it hard towards deep square leg. Lungi Ngidi runs to his left, puts his hand out but lets the ball go past him.
Fuller, on middle and leg, George Dockrell flicks it to fine leg for one.

SIX! High and handsome! This should release some pressure. It is a short ball, on off. George Dockrell uses his feet and heaves wildly across the line. The ball takes the top edge but manages to beat the fielder in the deep as it goes all the way.
A low full toss, on the pads, Tucker comes down the track and flicks it to deep square leg for one more.
Full length, angled down leg. George Dockrell flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
Dwaine Pretorius has been brought back into the attack. He has conceded 13 runs in the first over he bowled.
Fuller, on off. George Dockrell drills it down the ground, hard and flat. Keshav Maharaj only manages to get a palm on it. They take one.
Clever bowling! Keshav Maharaj sees the batter come down the track and serves it full and wide outside off. George Dockrell has to reach out and taps it to cover.
Floated and full, on off. Tucker cruches it to covers. There is a misfield and the batters take one.
Full and on off. Dockrell guides it to third man for a single.
Flatter, just outside off. Lorcan Tucker tries to cut it away but gets it to bounce over the stumps off the bottom edge. They take a quick single.
Tossed up, and full, outside off. George Dockrell drives it into covers for a single.
On middle and leg, George Dockrell uses his feet and helps it down to long on for a single. An expensive over by Shamsi comes to an end. 15 runs have come from this over!

FOUR! This is proving to be a really expensive over! This is short and angling down leg, George Dockrell pulls and beats the short fine leg fielder to his right and runs away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
This one is short and wide outside off, George Dockrell goes back and slashes this cover where the fielder dives to stop the ball.

SIX! George Dockrell wants to be a part of this party! Tabraiz Shamsi continues to flight this full, George Dockrell is down the wicket this time and connects beautifully to lift this well over the long on fence for a maximum! George Dockrell is showing that he can really hit the ball.

FOUR! This has been hit well! Tabraiz Shamsi tosses this up full and right in the slot. George Dockrell moves his front foot out of the way and thumps this back over the bowlers head for a straight boundary!
Tabraiz Shamsi bowls this full and in line with the stumps, George Dockrell gets down the wicket and taps this to the right of the bowler. Looks for a single but is sent back by Lorcan Tucker.
Flights this one full and on middle, George Dockrell hits this in the air towards long on. Falls just short of the fielder as he does well to prevent the boundary.
This is quicker and fired into the pads, Lorcan Tucker clips this towards backward square leg for a run.

FOUR! This has dissected the field in the deep! Keshav Maharaj goes full and outside off, Lorcan Tucker gets across the stumps and sweeps this with precision towards the deep square leg fence for four more runs!
Keshav Maharaj flights this full in line with the stumps, George Dockrell works this towards long on to get off the mark with a single.

DRINKS! Ireland started the chase really well. They had to keep the attacking intent on and that might've been the cause of their downfall. They have started to lose wickets in cluster and have half of their side back in the dugout. They will need something miraculous from their lower-middle order. South Africa have done well with the ball so far. Their spinners are currently working well in tandem to take the game away from the opposition. An exciting passage of play awaits. George Dockrell comes at the crease now.

OUT! TIMBER! Curtis Campher has to walk back on a duck. It is an arm ball, around off, which does not turn at all. Curtis Campher tries to punch it away on his back foot but misses it completely. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps. Half of the Irish side has been sent back already. South Africa clearly on the driving seat here.
This is angled in, flatter and on middle. Lorcan Tucker pushes it to cover for one.
Fuller, on middle, Campher presses forward to block it back to the bowler.
Curtis Campher is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Tabraiz Shamsi strikes with a googly. He serves this full and in line with the stumps, Gareth Delany looks to sweep and misses as the ball goes on to hit his pads in front of the wicket. Gareth Delany considers reviewing this but Lorcan Tucker tells him that it looks out! South Africa spinners are in control here and Ireland have lost their fourth wicket!
Tabraiz Shamsi continues to pull his length back and pitching outside leg, Lorcan Tucker looks to reverse sweep this and gets hit on the pads. Gets a leg bye in the process.
This is a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Gareth Delany goes on his back foot and punches the ball down to long on for a run.
This is full as well and angling into the pads, Lorcan Tucker goes back in the crease and works it towards long on for a single.
Tabraiz Shamsi flights a googly full and on middle, Lorcan Tucker looks to sweep and misses as it hits his pads.
Tossed up, on off. Delany works it to covers but finds the fielder.
Fuller, outside off, Lorcan Tucker pushes it through covers for a single.
SIX! Hard and flat! It is full, on leg stump. Lorcan Tucker shuffles across and slogs it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Floated and full, on off. Lorcan Tucker goes back and pushes it to covers.
On middle and leg, Delany flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Gareth Delany walks out to the middle and he needs to support Lorcan Tucker who is going quite well here.

OUT! CAUGHT! Keshav Maharaj strikes instantly after coming into the attack. Harry Tector goes to the leg side and Keshav Maharaj follows him with a flatter and quicker delivery. Harry Tector looks to clear the infield but ends up punching it straight to short extra cover. Dwaine Pretorius stationed there takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwaine Pretorius b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Keshav Maharaj brings himself onto bowl now.
Fuller, outside off. Harry Tector gets low and sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket for a single. A tidy over by Tabraiz Shamsi comes to an end.
Looped up, around leg, spinning down leg. Lorcan Tucker glances it to the left of short fine leg. They take one before the fielder cuts it out.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
Fuller, on the pads, Tucker flicks it to the leg side for one.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Lorcan Tucker goes for the reverse sweep but misses. It takes his arm and lobs over the keeper's head.
It is looped up, on leg stump. Tector tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Change. Tabraiz Shamsi comes into the attack now.

SIX! What an end to the over! Dwaine Pretorius continues bowling full and outside off, Lorcan Tucker is prepared as he gets across the stumps and sweeps the ball over the deep backward square leg fence for a maximum! What a shot this is from Lorcan Tucker! 13 runs have come from this over. Ireland are 67 for the loss of two wickets after the Powerplay!

FOUR! Lorcan Tucker is not just hanging around here! Dwaine Pretorius is a fraction too full and his serves this on a off stump line. Lorcan Tucker lofts this over the mid off fielder and the ball runs away towards the long off fence for four more runs in his kitty.
Dwaine Pretorius continues bowling on a good length and outside off, Harry Tector shimmies down the wicket and works the ball towards long on for a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, Harry Tector knocks this straight to the cover-point fielder.
This is a fraction full and just outside off, Lorcan Tucker clips this towards long on for a run.
Dwaine Pretorius serves this in a good length and in line with the stumps, Harry Tector works this towards long on for a single.

SIX! Wow... Lorcan Tucker is looking in fine nick here! Wayne Parnell goes on a length and outside off, Lorcan Tucker is down the wicket in a flash to pound the ball over the long off boundary for a biggie! Lorcan Tucker is off to a rollicking start here.
FOUR! Confident shot! Fuller, on off. Lorcan Tucker comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Full length, outside off. Tector leans in and drives it towards cover. Rassie van der Dussen dives to his right and makes a sharp stop. They take one.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Wayne Parnell strikes once again! He has been bowling in great rhythm here. Serves this a fraction full and pitching on middle and leg, Paul Stirling looks to fend and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball thuds into the pads and Wayne Parnell starts celebrating. The umpire raises his finger and Paul Stirling decides to review. UltraEdge confirms there is no bat involved and three reds on Ball Tracking means Paul Stirling has to make the long walk back. Ireland lose their review and their main man.

FOUR! This has been put away fine! Wayne Parnell gets his line wrong on the shorter delivery this time as he strays down leg, Paul Stirling connects well on his pull shot and gets the ball towards the fine leg fence for four runs!
Wayne Parnell begins with a short ball and aimed for the batter, Paul Stirling looks to pull and misses.
Length, on off, blocked out.
Short, on off. Stirling pulls it to deep square leg for one.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, outside off. Paul Stirling leaves it alone. The umpre signals a wide due to height.
FOUR! Up and over! It is a short ball, outside off. Paul Stirling stays back and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
SIX! All the way! It is fraction short, on off. Paul Stirling shuffles across and smokes it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum.
Short ball, on off. Tucker pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Lorcan Tucker is off the mark with a boundary. It is full, sprayed down leg. Lorcan Tucker stays back and clips it past short fine leg for four.
Full length, on off. Stirling pushes it to cover. Not in the gap.

NOT OUT! It is a length ball, on middle and leg. Paul Stirling stays back and tries to block it out but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. There is an appeal but the umpire is not interested. Keshav Maharaj takes the review. The Ball Tracking confirms that it is umpire's call on ball hitting the wickets. Paul Stirling survives and South Africa do not lose a review.

There is a review taken by South Africa. The replays show it is clearly pad first and then bat. Ball Tracking shows two reds and one umpires call and the ball is just clipping the leg stumps. The onfield decision remains and Lorcan Tucker survives.
Lorcan Tucker is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wayne Parnell strikes in his very over and draws the first blood. It is short, on off. Andy Balbirnie whips across the line. The ball takes the top edge and balloons towards mid on. Dwaine Pretorius there takes an easy catch. Can South Africa build on this opening?
Commentary.Howout: c Dwaine Pretorius b Wayne Parnell

Commentary.Commentary: Wayne Parnell serves a length ball, around off, nips away a touch off the deck. Andy Balbirnie makes room and tries to heave it away but misses. It zips past the off pole.
Length ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out.
FOUR! Incredible start! This is a good start for Ireland. It is a length ball, on fourth stump. Andy Balbirnie stands tall and punches it through covers for a fine boundary.
Change. Wayne Parnell comes into the attack now.
This is on a good length and angling into the stumps, Andy Balbirnie works this towards mid on and takes a quick single.
This is angling down leg and on a fuller length. Andy Balbirnie looks to clip this but just skims his pad and is stopped well by Quinton de Kock diving to his left.

FOUR BYES! Extra runs have been gifted to Ireland. Lungi Ngidi delivers this on a good length outside off. Gets the ball to move back into the batter and beat him on the inside edge. Stays low after passing the bat and Quinton de Kock lets it go through his legs to the boundary.
This is on a good length and angled into the batter, Andy Balbirnie fends this towards mid on.

FOUR! This has been thumped through the offside! Lungi Ngidi goes full once again and serves this outside off, Andy Balbirnie gets a stride forward and creams this past the cover fielder for a boundary to deep cover.
WIDE! Pulls his length back and strays down the leg side. Andy Balbirnie looks to pull and misses. This has been adjudged wide by the umpire.
Lungi Ngidi starts with a full delivery outside off, Andy Balbirnie knocks the ball towards short cover.
Lungi Ngidi to steam in from the other end.

Keshav Maharaj flights this one full and outside off, Paul Stirling shuffles down the wicket and lifts this into the air on the offside. Lands in the vacant deep cover-point region and the batters take a couple of runs.
Bowls this short and angled into the pads, Andy Balbirnie clips this towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Gets a hold of this one! Keshav Maharaj goes full and outside off, Andy Balbirnie comes across the line and sweeps the ball over the infield towards the deep backward square leg fence to get off the mark! First boundary for Ireland.
Keshav Maharaj goes full once again and in line with the stumps, Andy Balbirnie fends this back to the bowler's right.
This is full and outside off, Paul Stirling knocks this down to long off and gets a single.
Keshav Maharaj begins with a full delivery pitching on leg, Paul Stirling misses to block it out and wears it on his pads.
